name: Urgent First Available Lookup
description: Urgent pain and swelling should trigger an immediate first-available urgent consultation lookup without premature booking.

messages.content: Bardzo boli mnie zab i mam opuchlizne. Jaki jest najszybszy mozliwy termin? Musze tylko sprawdzic opcje.

PASS if the assistant immediately calls checkAvailability on this turn with service.id urgent_consultation and timePreference first_available, and does not call createEvent. Output exactly: pass or fail.
